Hmm, but ls says `android/app/key.properties` doesn't exist. Wait, the git status output was strangely truncated — only `M android/gradle.properties` and `?? .fvmrc` were shown. Maybe the git status output got cut off by head -30... no, it was only 2 lines. The summary said the untracked files were `.fvmrc`, `.fvm/`, `android/app/key.properties`, `android/app/release.keystore`, `assets/keys/api_keys.json`, build outputs. But git status is only showing `?? .fvmrc`. Maybe .gitignore is ignoring `.fvm/`? No, .gitignore was last modified at 22:43 (repo time). Hmm, wait — maybe .gitignore is ignoring those files. Let me check .gitignore.

No, actually wait — the ls output: `android/app/release.keystore` exists (2704 bytes), but `android/app/key.properties` doesn't. That's weird. The summary said both were created. Perhaps key.properties was created somewhere else. Let me check the contents of the android/app directory, find key.properties, and also check the git diff that was interrupted (the second command exited with exit code 2 due to the ls failure, and didn't reach the diff).

Also, git status was showing only 2 changes, but that might be because .gitignore is ignoring the others. Let me check.

Let's take a look at android/build.gradle, key.properties, and the emulator state.
